experiment: E5: end-to-end generation with ten seeds
question: Is the end-to-end ordering of Poisson, shared per-gene and per-cell scVI draws on marker recall, TSTR macro-F1 and rare-type F1 stable across ten seeds?
protocol: unchanged archived end-to-end protocol (experiments/phase2v_e2e_2026-07-19/run_e2e_multiseed.py run_one_seed): scVI gene and gene-cell fits, latents sampled from the prior, nearest-neighbour label transfer in the model latent, Poisson draw from the per-cell model's mean
summary: per arm: mean, standard deviation and range over ten seeds; per seed: ordering of the three draws; paired per-seed differences (per-cell minus Poisson, shared minus Poisson) with the number of seeds below zero and a seed-level 95% percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 20261108)
retention: all seeds retained; archived seeds are not refitted
